skills.text: When moving, account for slight deviations in distance and direction from the requested command.
If find fails, attempt the search again, as the object may be present but undetected.
When moving, plan movements cautiously to avoid triggering the safety refusal near the edge (S3).
To place an item, ensure the beak is positioned directly over the target object before opening the beak.
If the target object cannot be located by the vision model, do not assume the task is complete.
If the vision model fails to find the target, do not rely on the assumption that it is visible.
